name: polymancer
description: Paper-trade Polymarket by copying tracked wallets under your strategy and risk limits.

scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm agent-sdk:build && tsx scripts/run-with-log.ts output/dev/frontend.log pnpm exec next dev --webpack --disable-source-maps --hostname 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: pnpm observability:build && pnpm agent-sdk:build && pnpm client:build && tsx scripts/run-with-log.ts output/dev/frontend-build.log pnpm exec next build
scripts.prepare: pnpm observability:build && pnpm agent-sdk:build && pnpm client:build
scripts.e2e:seed: tsx scripts/reset-playwright-state.ts && wrangler d1 execute operloom_local --local --persist-to output/playwright/state --file cloudflare/control-plane/schema.sql --config cloudflare/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc --yes && wrangler d1 execute operloom_local --local --persist-to output/playwright/state --file tests/e2e/workbench-seed.sql --config cloudflare/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc --yes && tsx scripts/seed-e2e-complex-operator.ts
scripts.e2e:serve:runner: PORT=3101 OPERLOOM_E2E_MODE=true OPERLOOM_E2E_RUNNER_DELAY_MS=${OPERLOOM_E2E_RUNNER_DELAY_MS:-0} OPERLOOM_RUNNER_SIGNING_SECRET=e2e-runner-signing-secret-00000001 OPERLOOM_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET=e2e-callback-signing-secret-000001 OPERLOOM_CALLBACK_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8788 OPERLOOM_RUNNER_CALLBACK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 tsx scripts/run-with-log.ts output/playwright/runner.log pnpm start:runner
scripts.e2e:serve:worker: pnpm agent-sdk:build && pnpm e2e:seed && tsx scripts/run-with-log.ts output/playwright/worker.log wrangler dev --config cloudflare/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to output/playwright/state --port 8788 --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:http://localhost:3100 --var OPERLOOM_LOCAL_API_ENABLED:true --var OPERLOOM_ENVIRONMENT:local --var OPERLOOM_LOCAL_API_USER_ID:e2e-owner --var OPERLOOM_LOCAL_API_TOKEN:e2e-control-plane-token --var OPERLOOM_AGENT_CONNECTION_SECRET:e2e-agent-connection-secret-000001 --var OPERLOOM_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET:e2e-callback-signing-secret-000001 --var OPERLOOM_CALLBACK_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8788/workbench/run-callbacks --var OPERLOOM_RUNNER_TRANSPORT:fly --var OPERLOOM_RUNNER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:3101/workbench/tool-runners/invocations --var OPERLOOM_RUNNER_SIGNING_SECRET:e2e-runner-signing-secret-00000001 --var OPERLOOM_E2E_MODE:true --var OPERLOOM_E2E_EXPORT_PAUSE_MS:600 --var OPERLOOM_RETAINED_DATA_ENABLED:true --var OPERLOOM_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED:true --var OPERLOOM_MUTATIONS_ENABLED:true --var OPERLOOM_VAULT_BACKEND:memory --var 'OPERLOOM_OAUTH_PROVIDERS_JSON:[{"id":"synthetic-broker","authorizationUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:3101/e2e/oauth/authorize","tokenUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:3101/e2e/oauth/token","actionUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:3101/e2e/actions","clientId":"e2e-client","permittedHosts":["127.0.0.1"]}]'
scripts.test:e2e:local:release: OPERLOOM_E2E_RUNNER_DELAY_MS=0 E2E_RELEASE_MODE=local-session playwright test tests/e2e/release.spec.ts tests/e2e/operations-panel.spec.ts tests/e2e/workbench-accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.verify:environment-config: tsx scripts/check-environment.ts --target local --configuration-only && tsx scripts/check-environment.ts --target acceptance --configuration-only && tsx scripts/check-environment.ts --target production --configuration-only && tsx scripts/check-environment.ts --target demo --configuration-only
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm docs:check && pnpm observability:check && pnpm verify:onboarding && pnpm verify:environment-config && pnpm agent-packs:compile --check && pnpm agent-packs:validate && pnpm agent-sdk:verify && pnpm agent-sdk:contract --check && pnpm client:verify && pnpm client:contract --check && pnpm conformance:extension-contract && pnpm verify:runtime-architecture && pnpm db:cloudflare:migrations:verify && pnpm db:cloudflare:backup:verify && pnpm test:unit && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:fast && pnpm verify:security && pnpm build
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && pnpm conformance:client && pnpm conformance:data-lifecycle && pnpm conformance:connections && pnpm conformance:actions && pnpm conformance:agent-system && pnpm verify:docker && pnpm conformance:level2 && pnpm conformance:level3
scripts.agent-sdk:verify: pnpm agent-sdk:build && tsx scripts/verify-agent-sdk-consumer.ts && tsx scripts/verify-agent-sdk-consumer.ts --document-review && tsx scripts/verify-agent-sdk-consumer.ts --provider-operations
scripts.db:cloudflare:rebuild:local: wrangler d1 execute operloom_local --local --file cloudflare/control-plane/schema.sql --config cloudflare/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:cloudflare:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply operloom_local --local --config cloudflare/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc
